notes.title: Ice Cream Truck Wins Casual Prize at the 2020 Busan Indie Connect Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38575362/2ac8b268135db9efd3d814c719b6c733486166a1.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!
Today, the 2020 Busan Indie Connect Festival has ended.
Ice Cream Truck wins [b]Excellence in Casual prize[/b] in the rookie category!


2020 BIC Festival was held ONLINE due to COVID-19. We had a busy time preparing for BIC, and even after the exhibition started, 7 days passed really fast. But it was really fun to participate in game festivals with Ice Cream Truck and meet gamers. It was a very valuable time for us to receive reviews from various gamers.

We received a lot of feedback during this festival, some of which were completely new to us. In particular, there were opinions such as 'the UI and font size is small'. We were very excited because it was the first time we had the opportunity to receive reviews rather than bug reports from users! We will reflect the comments received this time in the development of the ice cream truck.

There were so many great games that we didn't think we would win. So we were very inspiring! yay! We hoped to bring this news to the community waiting for the Ice Cream Truck. Thank you!


Here is a link to the BIC Festival:
https://bicfest.org/

notes.title: Ice Cream Truck: Now you can play a demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38575362/343aa76691ffeb24953356d3397c1c2bfdac28ff.png[/img]

Now, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375040/Ice_Cream_Truck]Ice Cream Truck Demo[/url] has been released. In this free demo version, you can play up to <Tada Land>. Drive your truck to the new world Right Now!

[b]Ice Cream Truck[/b] is a game where the plot progresses by selling ice cream that brings about certain emotions in customers. From sad customers to angry or scared ones, even intolerable ones… Offer some ice cream to the many different customers that come to your truck. The plot will evolve according to the player’s choice. Within the different events, make the decision that is the most appealing. What is it that you consider the most important?

Demo 1.2.3 version
[list]
[*][b]Language:[/b] Korean, English
[*][b]OS:[/b] Windows
[/list]
